run_save_images: run the script to save representative images from domain generalization datasets to disk
save_images_from_datasets: save 50 random images per environment from OfficeHome, TerraIncognita, DomainNet, RotatedMNIST, ColoredMNIST, and SVIRO datasets
denormalize_and_export_images: denormalize torch tensor images using ImageNet mean/std and export as PNG files via imageio
handle_grayscale_images: handle 2-channel grayscale images by padding with a zero channel to create 3-channel RGB tensors
filter_images_by_class: filter out images with class labels greater than 10 when randomly sampling from dataset environments
